name: Grace Window
author: CoolJam
description: Reopen closed window, including its content with SUPER+SHIFT+W. The plugin rebinds SUPER+W to move the focused window silently to workspace 10 with a one-minute reopen grace period until it gets closed for real. Uninstall the plugin with "~/.config/omarchy/plugins/jam.grace-window/uninstall.sh". Do not uninstall via omarchy's plugin system, otherwise you will need to remove the plugin's managed block from "~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua" manually to restore your previous keybindings.
